author: (C. B. Adams, 1850)

note.en: A tiny curved, glassy eulimid snail, a parasite of echinoderms, known from INBio samples at 8 to 14 m off Manzanillo and in the Gandoca-Manzanillo refuge.
note.es: Un caracol eulímido diminuto, curvo y vítreo, parásito de equinodermos, conocido por muestras del INBio entre 8 y 14 m frente a Manzanillo y en el refugio Gandoca-Manzanillo.

evidence: GBIF: 5 museum specimens (INBio), Manzanillo and the refuge, 1999 to 2002

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records for the region box (INBio Atta collection, iNaturalist)

recWhy: Recorded: GBIF: 5 museum specimens (INBio), Manzanillo and the refuge, 1999 to 2002.

marks.en: Tiny, glassy, smooth, slightly curved shell; lives on echinoderms.
marks.es: Concha diminuta, vitrea, lisa y algo curvada; vive sobre equinodermos.
